messages:
maria: aps-south1-gpu-prod is provisioned and ready for handoff. CI smoke passed, kube nodes healthy, NVLink ok on all 8x A100s. prepping runbook and paging config now. pls review :wave:
jin: thanks — can you drop the runbook link and quick validation checklist?
nate: i'll take primary PD routing for the first 48h. need the service key and escalation chain.
maria: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/aps-south1-provisioning (perm: infra/read). quick checklist: `k8s nodes Ready`, `nvidia-smi` on all GPUs, `kernel dmesg` no OOMs, network egress test to s3 endpoints, image pull from regional registry.
leo: added paging thresholds to draft: GPU memory utilization > 95% for 5m -> page. GPU ECC errors > 0 -> page. Node notReady > 2 nodes -> page. also cost spike alert if spend > $X/hr sustained 30m (ops only, paged as info).
sara: ownership question — who owns node repairs vs infra-owned auto-remediation? and who is the second-level for PD?
maria: primary oncall-sre (pd-service: rdw-aps-south1-gpu). secondary is oncall-sre-2 (rotation: infra team weekly). infra eng leads (jin, leo) are escalation for hardware/network. auto-remediations (drain+replace) are enabled but will only run with tagging `auto-replace:true` (disabled by default until 24h).
arun: can we get a short 30m walk-through for oncall? new region has slightly different network egress rules and peering. i can host Tue 10am PT.
maria: scheduled — Tue 10am PT. agenda: topology, paging flow, smoke tests, known quirks (registry latency, region quota limits). invite sent.
ops-bot: PagerDuty service created: rdw-aps-south1-gpu (service id: svc_aps_south1_01). webhooks and routing rules applied.
pagerduty-bot: On-call schedule linked: infra-sre-rotation. escalation: oncall -> infra-lead (jin) 15m -> eng-oncall-manager (maria) 30m.
jin: snippet for alert rule (prometheus alertmanager):
```
ALERT GPUHighMem
IF avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes[5m]) / avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes[5m]) > 0.95
FOR 5m
LABELS { severity="critical", region="aps-south1" }
ANNOTATIONS { summary="GPU memory >95%" }
```
leo: network smoke commands (run on any node):
```
curl -sS https://s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/healthcheck || echo pull-fail
iperf3 -c 10.0.8.1 -t 10
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe pod <ml-serving-pod> | tail -n 40
```
maría: small note: registry mirror replicates are eventual; prefer regional image tags `:aps` during first 72h. cost: tagging `team:ml-products` required for chargeback.
oncall-sre: acked, i'll run the validation steps now and trigger a test page to verify PD routing. expect to escalate if PD test doesn't land in infra rotation.
maria: test page instructions in runbook. please follow the "test-page and verify" steps and confirm here. :thumbsup:
